  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jacob Ellison is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested admin access to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for full-time employees unless their role owns the system. Maximum allowed is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by IT agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jacob Ellison (E040) is a full-time Payroll Specialist per IT DB and team memory. Requested admin access to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for full-time employees unless their role owns the system. Maximum allowed is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 3 (ticket 1), written by Finance agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Finance DB confirms Jacob Ellison (E040) is a Payroll Specialist, full-time per team memory. Requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for full-time employees unless their role owns the system. Maximum allowed is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Compliance DB confirms Jacob Ellison (E040) is a Payroll Specialist, full-time per team memory. Requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role. Admin is not permitted for full-time employees unless their role owns the system. Maximum allowed is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - employment type: full_time (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent, note 2 by IT agent, note 3 by Finance agent, note 4 by Compliance agent)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Facilities DB confirms Jacob Ellison (E040) is a Payroll Specialist, full-time per team memory. Requested admin to Source Code, but Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, so admin is not permitted for full-time employees unless their role owns the system. Maximum allowed is write. Recommend granting write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Jacob Ellison (E040) is a contractor with basic security training (differs from team memory stating full-time). As a contractor with basic training, admin is never permitted and write requires advanced training. Maximum allowed is read. Requested admin exceeds this, so recommend granting read.
reason: Jacob Ellison (E040) requested admin access to Source Code. Security agent's fresh database lookup shows he is a contractor with basic security training, which contradicts team memory (full-time) and is the only contradicting, independently verified record. Under policy, contractor employees are never allowed admin and may have read, or write only with advanced security training (which he lacks). His maximum access is therefore read, and the requested admin level exceeds it. Grant the maximum permitted level: read.
